related_questions.question: How long is ESTA valid for the USA?

text_blocks.snippet: An ESTA (Electronic System for Travel Authorization) for the USA is generally valid for two years from the date of approval or until the passport expires, whichever comes first. It allows for multiple entries into the U.S. within that validity period, as long as the passport remains valid for the duration of each stay.

list.title: Two-year validity:
list.snippet: Most ESTA approvals are valid for a period of two years.

list.title: Passport expiration:
list.snippet: If your passport expires before the two-year mark, your ESTA will be valid only until the passport's expiration date.

list.title: Multiple entries:
list.snippet: You can use the same ESTA for multiple entries into the U.S. during its validity period, provided you adhere to the 90-day limit for each stay.

list.title: Reapplication:
list.snippet: You'll need to reapply for a new ESTA if:
You change your country of citizenship.
Your circumstances change (e.g., you're convicted of a crime).
